app.name: Sahakar Sathi
app.tagline: Your multilingual digital assistant for cooperative services, schemes, insurance and financial guidance.

home.heroHeading: Get clear answers about cooperative services in your language.
home.heroSub: Ask about schemes, crop insurance, PACS, cooperative rules, money matters, or how to file a grievance. You can type or speak.
home.askPlaceholder: Type your question, for example: Am I eligible for PMFBY?
examples: Am I eligible for PMFBY crop insurance?
How do I become a cooperative member?
How can I file a cooperative grievance?
home.grievanceCalloutTitle: Have a complaint about a cooperative or PACS?
home.grievanceCalloutBody: Raise it here. You will get a tracking number and can check the status any time.
home.trustNote: Answers are drawn from official government and cooperative sources where available. The assistant clearly marks what is verified and what is a plain-language explanation.

schemes.title: Government schemes
schemes.desc: Find schemes for farmers and cooperative members, and check who can apply.

pmfby.desc: Eligibility, premium, documents, and how to report crop loss.

pacs.title: PACS services
pacs.desc: Membership, credit, deposits, inputs, storage and procurement.

cooperative.title: Cooperative rules
cooperative.desc: Membership rights, duties, elections, meetings and by-laws in simple words.

money.title: Money basics
money.desc: Saving, interest, loans, EMI, insurance and avoiding fraud.

grievance.title: Grievance help
grievance.desc: How to raise a complaint and what happens after you submit it.

common.offlineBody: Educational pages still work. The assistant needs an internet connection.

footer.disclaimer: Sahakar Sathi provides general guidance and links to official sources. It is not a substitute for official government or legal advice.
